findings.title: uv run pytest exits 1 on unrelated test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused
findings.evidence: 03-verification+gate.txt lines 79-100: DID NOT RAISE Refused; 1 failed, 1653 passed, 1 skipped; run under root (/tmp/pytest-of-root), where chmod 0o500 does not block writes. Diff touches no run_review_checks code. Not verified against the base commit.
findings.consequence: The phase's own pytest verification does not exit 0 in the runner, though the cause appears environmental and unrelated to the diff.
findings.minimal_fix: Run the verification as non-root, or skip that test when geteuid()==0 (outside this phase).

findings.title: No test pins the schema_version bump, the R03 slot/panel-id disjointness, or the R05 stale-storage discard
findings.evidence: test_shipped_layout_schema_version_is_bumped still asserts >= 2; schema minimum is 2; ts/src has only ErrorBoundary.test.tsx and wiring.test.tsx, none touching storage.
findings.consequence: Reverting the bump or reintroducing a slot id equal to a panel id would stay green; R05 and ADR-016 decision 3 rest on code reading only.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a pytest asserting schema_version == 3 and no slot_id appears in any panel_id, and a vitest checking loadStoredState(3) returns null when only a v2 key is stored.

findings.title: Some comments still say terminal/main slot in prose

findings.consequence: Cosmetic only; the ruling accepts role-naming prose.
